plan.description: Read the malignant single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy. This step involves loading the .h5ad file containing gene expression profiles and malignancy classifications into an AnnData object for further processing.
input_filename: /cs/student/projects2/aisd/2024/shekchu/projects/cell_agents/biomaster/output/cell_annotation_o3mini/malignant_classification.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq breast cancer dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes, gene names, and malignancy classifications.
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/initialized_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object with loaded malignant cell data

plan.description: Subset the malignant cells from the loaded dataset. Since the dataset includes malignancy classifications, filter the AnnData object to retain only cells labeled as malignant for further sub-analysis.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/initialized_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object with loaded malignant cell data
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/subset_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object containing only malignant cells

plan.description: Perform normalization and identify highly variable genes on the subset malignant cells. This step is essential to make the gene expression comparable across cells and to reduce noise for downstream clustering analysis.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/subset_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object containing only malignant cells
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/normalized_malignant_cells.h5ad: Normalized AnnData object with highly variable genes annotated

plan.description: Conduct dimensionality reduction and clustering analysis on the normalized malignant cells. Apply PCA for dimensionality reduction followed by constructing a neighborhood graph and performing Leiden clustering to identify distinct cell clusters. This clustering will assist in differentiating cell states based on gene expression profiles.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/normalized_malignant_cells.h5ad: Normalized AnnData object with highly variable genes annotated
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/clustering_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object with PCA, neighborhood graph, and Leiden cluster labels

plan.description: Identify marker genes for each malignant cell cluster and classify cell states. Based on known markers for cell proliferation, quiescence, and slow-cycling states, annotate each cluster accordingly as quiescent, proliferating, or slow-cycling. This step involves differential expression analysis between clusters to determine state-specific markers.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/clustering_malignant_cells.h5ad: AnnData object with PCA, neighborhood graph, and Leiden cluster labels
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/cell_state_classification.h5ad: Annotated AnnData object with cell state labels (quiescent, proliferating, or slow-cycling) for malignant cells

plan.description: Save and export the final annotated AnnData object containing cell state classifications. The output file includes updated cell metadata with the assigned cell state labels, which can be further visualized or used for downstream analysis.
input_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/cell_state_classification.h5ad: Annotated AnnData object with cell state labels
output_filename: ./output/o3_dormancy/final_cell_state_classification.h5ad: Final annotated single-cell dataset with malignant cells classified as quiescent, proliferating, or slow-cycling
